name: Chinese Shrimp Fried Rice
description: An easy Chinese-style fried rice with shrimp, eggs, mixed vegetables, soy sauce, oyster sauce, and white pepper. Adapted from Rasa Malaysia.
recipeIngredient: 6 cups leftover steamed rice, chilled overnight
6 dashes ground white pepper (or black pepper)
recipeInstructions: Use the back of a spoon to gently break up any lumps in the chilled rice, then set it aside.
Heat 2 tablespoons of the oil in a wok or skillet over high heat. Add the eggs and use a spatula to break them into small pieces as they cook. Remove the cooked eggs and set them aside.
Heat the remaining oil in the wok or skillet over high heat. Add the garlic and stir-fry until aromatic or lightly browned.
Add the shrimp. When they begin to cook, add the mixed vegetables and stir quickly several times.
Add the rice and stir-fry continuously. Add the soy sauce, oyster sauce, and white pepper, then continue to stir-fry until the shrimp are fully cooked and the rice is lightly toasted.
Return the eggs to the wok and stir until thoroughly combined. Add salt to taste and serve immediately.
